`demo/judge_calibration/` holds {{calib.labels.n}} answers from the three demo versions with a yes/no label each for "correct" and "supported". The offline lexical rubric judge agrees with the labels on {{calib.judges.rubric_lexical.correct.agreement|.0%}} of answers for correctness (Cohen's kappa {{calib.judges.rubric_lexical.correct.kappa|.2f}}) and {{calib.judges.rubric_lexical.supported.agreement|.0%}} for support (kappa {{calib.judges.rubric_lexical.supported.kappa|.2f}}). **These kappas are provisional:** the labels have status `{{calib.labels.status}}` and await the owner's review, so they measure agreement with unreviewed labels. The model judges (rubric, and pairwise with position swapping) are implemented and tested offline but have not been calibrated against a live model yet.
